name: SK Hynix
day_summary: SK Hynix rose +1.4% to ₩260,950 as HBM-supply and AI-capex headlines lifted the memory complex. Longs and the foreign bid kept the uptrend going; the stock pushed toward the upper half of its range.

decision.rationale: The HBM leadership thesis is working and foreign buyers are pressing it. BUY/own the leader; add on dips rather than chase strength into resistance.

positioning.notable_flow: Foreign institutions adding to the AI-memory leader; call-like momentum buying in the cash market.

what_traders_are_doing: Momentum longs pressing SK Hynix as the cleanest Asian AI-infrastructure name; foreign inflows steady.

news.label: AI-capex optimism and tight HBM supply lift SK Hynix and the memory complex

bull_case: Tight HBM supply underpins pricing power.
Foreign inflows and momentum favor the leader.
bear_case: Approaching resistance; chasing strength is poor risk/reward.
FX and concentration risk always present.
